records.text: Owens said her show was already in the global top ten before Charlie Kirk died and that every episode of its podcast launched in 2024 had averaged more than one million views.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Our show before Charlie (Charlie Kirk) died was already in the top 10 globally, sitting above the Charlie Kirk podcast and every single episode of our new podcast since we launched it back in 2024 has averaged well above a million views. Go back and check that.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting says the independent Candace show debuted into a podcast top ten, and current public records show several-million-view episodes, including more than seven million views for the September 2025 tribute. Those sources support a large pre-assassination audience. They do not establish the precise claim of a global top-ten rank immediately before September 10, 2025 or prove that every episode since the 2024 launch averaged more than one million views across a consistently defined metric.
